_help: Rules for `listen world entities` and `listen world merge --entities static`. An entity is dropped when it moved more than max_move blocks over the capture (all its position records), or when any custom name it ever had matches a drop_names regex (on the plain text, colors removed), unless any of its names matches a keep_names regex. Everything else is kept, including unnamed stands and unknown names that stayed still. Edit freely; regexes are Python re, searched anywhere in the name.
